unsourced: The NFL's own partners directory: nfl.com/business/league-partners/, nfl.com/business/nfl-partners/ and nfl.com/partners/ all returned 404 on 2026-09-25; operations.nfl.com/gameday/nfl-partners/ also 404. The league does not publish a single crawlable partners list at these URLs - the official roster needs a different route (press releases, NFL OnePass/partner announcements).

Known NFL league-level partners reported in trade press but not opened/sourced this run: Verizon (wireless), Microsoft (Surface/technology), Nike (onside apparel/official outfitting), Gatorade (sports drink), Caesars Entertainment (casino partner), FanDuel (sportsbook), Visa, Intuit/TurboTax, Amazon Web Services (cloud; aws already in corpus), Bose, Pizza Hut, Candy (Ministry of Supply?), Tile Shop, Next Gen Stats partner Zebra Technologies, and Bud Light/Michelob Ultra (Anheuser-Busch, anheuser-busch-owner already in corpus). None of these has a source URL opened and verified this run - each needs its own announcement before a deal row is written.

Broadcast partners are media-rights deals, not sponsorships in the corpus's sense: CBS, Fox, NBC, ESPN/ABC, Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, YouTube TV (from the NFL's current seven-media-partner package). No deals rows written for them; flag for modelling whether 'league-partner' should include media partners.

Super Bowl halftime-show title sponsorship history: Pepsi held the halftime sponsorship before Apple Music (Pepsi Super Bowl Halftime Show era); start year of the Apple Music deal not confirmed this run - only that Super Bowl LX (2026-02-08) ran as the Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show.

Invisalign NFL Honors deal: only the 10th annual (2020 season, aired Feb 2021) presentation confirmed via the archived NFL Communications release; whether Invisalign still presents NFL Honors in the 2026-27 season was not verified.

LA Rams x Visit Rwanda stadium partnership (rams-visit-rwanda) and all 32 club stadium/practice-patch deals already exist in normalized/deals.json from the US ingest pass; this file deliberately adds no club-level rows.
